reviews.title: Perfect app
reviews.text: I use this app daily to learn spanish.

reviews.title: So glad I found it
reviews.text:
This methodology for learning Spanish has completely changed my expectations for learning a new language! I used to think it would be impossible for me to stick to it, but I have now watched over 50 hours of videos in just over a month. Without any prior Spanish learning, I can actually say that I understand the (albeit easy) videos I’m watching whereas before they would’ve just sounded like noise.

With so much free content to start with you should definitely give it a shot.

reviews.title: Great app
reviews.text:
Great app and website, the video tracking is very consistent.

Like others said, the ability to use the app in landscape mode would be a big plus!

reviews.title: love
reviews.text: i love dreaming spanish

reviews.title: Needs subtitles
reviews.text: As a beginner, it would be helpful to see the words in both Spanish and English. Just hearing the words and not having any clue how they are spelled or written out makes it very difficult to learn.

reviews.title: Dreaming French
reviews.text: I've only been doing Dreaming French for a couple of weeks and so far so good. I've had no tech issues at all. I love that not only do they keep track of my progress, but they also allow me to add content that is comprehensible input but from outside sources. Only thing I don't like is that I find the content a touch childish. ("How am I feeling today" or dinosaurs?) I realize beginners need easy basic content but maybe a bit more subjects that adults can appreciate. Overall though a fun way to learn a new language.

reviews.title: It’s OK
reviews.text:
This is a hard thing to do, make engaging content consistently. After a while I became less engaged. Most of the videos are someone speaking alone, not conversations. Honestly, they just run out of stuff to talk about that’s engaging.

Also the app is buggy, which is weird since they seem to host their video with Vimeo. There’s a bug where the video disappears when you’re in landscape mode. Honestly, I just got sick of dealing with it.

reviews.title: Overall good but a suggestion
reviews.text: I like the content but I wish there was a way to play videos while my phone is locked, so that I don’t need to keep the app open

reviews.title: A game changer!
reviews.text: I had been stuck in other apps learning vocab. It wasn’t what I needed to get to real daily conversations. Three weeks of daily videos (one or two) and I had already started dreaming in Spanish. The best part, my dreams captured the humor that is incorporated into the videos. I love and look forward to watching them! Very entertaining.

reviews.title: Amazing resource!
reviews.text: I’ve been wanting to learn Spanish for a while and came across recommendations for dreaming Spanish. I’ve been blown away with all of the resources in the app and how easy it is to consume interesting content! It’s made learning such a joy. I also love seeing the improvements in video quality over the years as I watch a mix of older and newer videos. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: LOVE IT BUT TOO BUGGY
reviews.text: Regretfully the last few times I’ve tried to watch I’ve had so many issues with the video not coming on or lagging or other delays that I have eventually gotten frustrated and given up. Please look at the app and fix it. I really love the app when it works.

reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text: With a recent update the screen no longer flips to landscape. No me gusta.

reviews.title: Life changing
reviews.text: If you actually want to learn another language, this is the way. Please do Mandarin next! 🇨🇳

reviews.title: Full screen??
reviews.text: I like the site and the approach, but I don’t understand why it seems impossible to get a full screen view of the video on the app. Back when they used a PWA (website saved on your phone), it was trivial—you just pressed the full screen button. But for some reason I don’t see it at all on this new mobile app. Please fix that. Otherwise, a bug fan of the approach, just not the app.

reviews.title: Best language learning hands down
reviews.text:
The Dreaming team and comprehensible input is the best way to learn a language, I am convinced. 

I am 1st generation English speaking in my family, both parents 1st language is Spanish (Puerto Rico) but I didn't grow up knowing Spanish as they divorced and remarried English speakers. Although I was around it, I could kind of understand but not speak and I didn't know why. Pablo, the co-founder of dreaming, is a linguistic genius and makes sense of it in his start here video series. Once it was explained and I really dove into the science, I trusted it and everything made sense. 

It is simple to find out what level you can begin but in general, all you do is watch the content that your enjoy and understand. The topics range so much, and especially if you like travel videos, you can watch for hours and forget it's even in Spanish. You eventually feel like the dreaming team is your friends/family. The podcast is some of my favorite especially in the car or while doing chores. 

They have French and I hope they continue to add other languages as it's a game changer. I have too many good things to write, I only say that I highly recommend. It's great to go find Pablo's early videos on YouTube as well to see where it began and the method behind the madness. 

My only gripe is I wish I could comment on the videos or have a community chat within the app and not just on YouTube or on the website. If you can and I am just missing it, let me know!

reviews.title: Great on iPhone
reviews.text:
08/16/2026

I would give it a 5 stars just for the iPhone. App works great. The problem is the iPad version doesn’t work well as you can’t do landscape mode so you have to flip back and forth while watching videos. It would be nice to have it work well for iPads too. reviews.title: Please add landscape support for iPad!
reviews.text: Love Dreaming but I have to use the web version, since the iPad app doesn’t support landscape mode.

reviews.title: El programa sí. La aplicación no.
reviews.text: Puede aprender mucho del Español con Dreaming Spanish. Pero, la aplicación no funciona bien. La tiene mucho bugs. Necesita mejorarla. Por ejemplo, cada vez me pongo el tiempo fuera del programa en el “progress”, se desaparece el barra de herramientas y puedo reiniciar el app.

reviews.title: Great learning method, app needs a few tweaks.
reviews.text:
This app is _mostly_ a good way to view the Dreaming Spanish content, except for two big drawbacks: 
1. There is no landscape mode on iPad for the menu. It _will_ switch to landscape if you make the video full screen, but if you go back to the menu, it will rotate the screen sideways which is difficult to use.
2. The subtitle timing is _slightly_ off. It advances about a second too fast. There is no adjustment (that I have  found) in the app to delay it. All videos seem to have subtitles that are off by about the same amount.

reviews.title: Great app but has a bug
reviews.text: Great app and videos! for some reason my videos aren’t letting me move around the time scrubber and will sometimes reset to the beginning of the video and my time isn’t counting! i’ll delete this  in a little just wanted to let you guys know!

reviews.title: Great content, Completely Broken Subtitles
reviews.text:
Lots of great content at all different levels for learning, but when trying to use this as a supplement to other methods of learning Spanish, it fails pretty badly with the subtitles. Considering the sole purpose of the app is teaching you a language, it’s kind of unacceptable how horrible the subtitles work. 

Skipping back ten seconds to hear something again? Subtitles gone (even though they still show as being on in the toggle menu. Scrubbed the video back or forward at all? Subtitles now out of sync. Accidentally changed phone orientation? Subtitles shrink then disappear. Watching a video in its entirety without causing touching anything? Subtitles still get out of sync regularly. 

Please fix this.

reviews.title: Request
reviews.text: Hello! This is a fantastic app. I have one request though. Would yall be able to add more kid friendly super beginner and beginner videos to your play list? I’ve been on this Dreaming Spanish Journey with my 4 year old. He loves Calcetin!

reviews.title: Listening Comprehension
reviews.text: Duolingo has been great except for listening comprehension. I feel Dreaming is the perfect complement. They speak slower, and the storied and even acting are good. I’m a big fan.

reviews.title: Wish I could love it, but disappointed
reviews.text:
The individual creators are great, BUT there’s a lot of AI usage in the videos for the images.

Would love to watch Dreaming Spanish to see Shel and Andrea and Agustina (fantastic teachers), and be safe/secluded from a world of seeing fake not-real dogs, or an AI Sasquatch. 

Use stock images rather than AI! it really cheapens the product that you didn’t put human effort into the ugly ‘art’. Also when the images are so clearly AI, what’s that saying about the scripts?

reviews.title: THE way to learn.
reviews.text: This app is changing my life one day at a time. As someone half-Hispanic, I’ve felt out of touch with so much of my family for as long as I can remember. I was 50% Hispanic by blood and 90% Floridian (culturally, anyway). Once I finally decided to try and learn to get back in touch, finding this channel on YouTube, then their website, then their app here has gotten me from barely getting through Duolingo to understanding advanced content and having basic conversations with my Spanish-speaking parent and kind strangers I meet. I’m around 110 hours in and have many hours of input to go until fluency, but the content is so refreshingly unique and fun and qwirky that I can have a great time watching it any time! Thank you Dreaming for connecting me to my roots and igniting a new passion in me for language learning and connecting with the rest of the world someday!! Keep it up! You’re bringing the world closer together! Can’t wait to see what’s next for you guys 🙏😁

reviews.title: Need Premium to Cast to TV in the background
reviews.text: Premium is totally worth it to me not only for casting to TV but thousands of extra videos episode

reviews.title: Duolingo, Memrise, Lingvist Failed, Dreaming Succeeded
reviews.text: I have been trying to learn Spanish since last 5 years or so and have tried Duolingo, Memrise and even paid for Lingvist. I hoped I will finally learn it but none worked really and I dropped the apps soon. It was tiresome. Dreaming gets this right by avoiding the memorising part and writing part. Just watch videos and learn Spanish. That’s how babies learn. I am using Dreaming for 3 months and my interest grew more and more. Now I cant live a day without watching at least 2-3 videos from DS. Kudos to the team for creating the greatest app for learning languages. Keep adding more languages.

reviews.title: Best way to learn Spanish
reviews.text:
Initially, I was a a bit skeptical about learning Spanish through this comprehensible method. However, I forgot that as a kid, we never learned the grammar. We accepted the input from our parents, friends, and other sources and understood it through context. 

50 hours into the material I can say my Spanish has improved considerably. This is way better than grinding Duolingo for hours without seeing any noticeable difference. 

The app allows you to set daily goals and shows you your monthly and overall progress. 

I want to thank Pablo and the entire Dreaming for putting in so much effort into this platform. Once I complete Spanish, I will start with the French course. This is amazing!

reviews.title: Best ever
reviews.text: It uses the method of millions of polyglots que it was a YouTube channel that grow into a business

reviews.title: Degrading their service to be just another app
reviews.text:
Dreaming Spanish had a very strong start as a useful and powerful website. That is now being degraded constantly to get people to use this app. It’s less and less a passion project to spread language learning. It’s now just another edutainment app to compete with all the others language apps on the stores. It’s not about spreading language, it’s about growth hacking and getting to the top of the download charts. En**itification has come for Dreaming Languages. 

btw, if you’re going to kill your website, at least make a really good app instead of launching half baked with critical features missing like fullscreen viewing or tablet support.

reviews.title: I love dreaming Spanish!!
reviews.text: Thank you for making this amazing app! It makes it easy and fun to learn Spanish

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: just try it… After consistently watching and listening daily every month I see progress with my Spanish. I can now watch series & listen to podcasts and music without English subtitles. The paid version is not required but so worth it & a great way to support the professors/content creators!!!! P.s. While there are some bugs within the app, it doesn’t hinder my learning one bit.

reviews.title: App is missing some features but still GREAT
reviews.text: The app is essentially the website in mobile format. Missing a few minor features but still very very solid and worth supporting. The team takes feedback on not only content, but on how the app works as well. Premium opens up a PLETHORA of new content so it is very worth it. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: No Picture-in-Picture😩😩
reviews.text:
This app has 10/10 content, but the lack of Picture-in-Picture support on iPhone is a major drawback. I purchased Premium hoping to watch videos in PiP mode, but only the audio continues playing when I leave the app.

For me, Picture-in-Picture would add tremendous value and make it much easier to fit Dreaming Spanish into my daily routine. It’s one of the few features I feel is truly missing from an otherwise excellent app. I would even be willing to pay extra for PiP support if necessary.

reviews.title: Good way to learn Spanish. Just a bit buggy app
reviews.text: Really excellent way to learn Spanish through comprehensible input. It makes it more fun but the reason I am giving only 4 stars is sometimes I cannot exit the video in the app or the whole app goes dark except for the video then I have to maximize and minimize the video a few times to get the app to work again.

reviews.title: One of the best learning language methods
reviews.text: This should be the automatic way of learning for all children and adults. It is simple fun and easy. I love dreaming Spanish!

reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.text: Finding Dreaming has been the best thing to happen to my language learning journey. It takes time (years) to learn a language and any app telling you otherwise is lying. You have to put in the time but Dreaming Spanish makes it so fun and not feel like work. highly recommend!

reviews.title: Daily habit with real results
reviews.text:
I started watching/listening every day on the website about 18 months ago and my Spanish comprehension has grown so much. This is by far the best method for me. The content is engaging and I often exceed my daily goal just because I’m enjoying what I’m watching. 

The app has a few advantages over the website: if you turn your screen off, the video audio keeps playing so it’s great for listening on walks and such. I also like the courses section in the app (it seems to be all the videos ordered by relative difficulty). 

I hope they keep growing the platform - I’d love to apply this technique to every language I’ve ever had an interest in!

reviews.title: Kinda hooked!
reviews.text: After trying several ways to learn Spanish I decide to give dreaming Spanish a try. I set my daily goal at 30 mins. A week of that and I moved my goal as I was getting much more input than that. I’m up to 2 hours a day and I’m addicted! I’m understanding so much more than I ever have before! The app lets you set your own goals, track progress and how long until the next level. You can hide watched videos if you so choose or go back and rewatch them. It’s easy to sort based on all types of criteria. I’ve recommended this to everyone I know! I have the paid version but the free is just a good! Do yourself a favor and use this if you want to learn Spanish!

reviews.title: Luv DS.
reviews.text: Only way 2 learn really. Everything else bores the heck out of me.

reviews.title: Worth your time
reviews.text: I’ve tried so many other Spanish programs and always quit out of frustration. This is the only one I’ve stuck with. It takes awhile to understand and really apply the concepts of comprehensible input language learning but once you  get the philosophy and trust it, learning becomes more natural. I recommend reading the FAQ and learning about the process on the website Dreaming Languages. I can understand basic Spanish conversations among native speakers now and am surprising myself at how much I’m able to comprehend with each month spent watching videos.  And I love all the content creators. Very interesting and likable people. It feels like a group of friends. I highly recommend the app without reservation.

reviews.title: Best way to learn Spanish
reviews.text: I’ve been doing this for about a year, first on the website now on the app. I can understand most conversations in Spanish, especially at slower speeds. The app is great, keeps track of your input hours and everything. Love everything about Dreaming Spanish.

reviews.title: Spanish
reviews.text: Best Spanish method for me as it keeps me consistent. Maybe not the fastest but the most enjoyable way to learn a new language. Trust the process.

reviews.title: Best Way to Learn a Language
reviews.text: This app has changed the way I think about language acquisition. It’s such an easy way to improve your comprehension and speaking. I’ve now logged 400+ hours and have gone from hardly understanding the beginner videos to being able to enjoy native content. At times I forget shows are in Spanish!! I could not recommend this enough!!!

reviews.title: 100% Works
reviews.text: In June of 2020 (when this service was only a Patreon) I began spending 3 hours a day listening to and watching Dreaming Spanish. By August of that summer, I was able to have full fledged conversations with my now in-laws, both native speakers from Mexico. Just this last weekend, my wife’s grandmother visited from Mexico and I was able to speak comfortably with her. If you dedicate the time and follow the rules Pablo sets out for you you’re guaranteed to be able to speak at an intermediate level.

reviews.text: the only thing that i wish they would do differently is i wish they had english subtitles so i can understand what im listening to because half the time i may lose the story or have a couple different phrases that could go with a certain word if anyone understands me lmk its also my first week using dreaming although i do love it.

reviews.title: Me gusta de app de Dreaming
reviews.text: Y me gusta mucha Ester y Andrés y Mitch y Agustina y toda empleos de Dreaming Spanish. Buenos suerte !

reviews.title: El mejor manera a aprender español
reviews.text:
Started Dreaming Spanish in May of 2024. Now in May of 2026, I’ve reached 1500 hours of listening, 20 hours speaking with a tutor, and have read a handful of books. I am now at the point where I am starting to think and speak in Spanish with confidence. This is a long journey and I’m far from done, but I want to thank the Dreaming Spanish team because I would have never made it to this point without them. 

My time with Dreaming is over for now as I have graduated to watching content like Telenovelas and natives on YouTube. I will come back one day to learn French but for now this is a thank you and a goodbye.

reviews.title: So convenient to take Dreaming anywhere
reviews.text: This app delivers all the things I love about the web version and more!  Being able to download videos so I can watch them at work on my lunch break is great because WiFi isn’t the best at my job.  Navigating the app is easy and the layout and presentation are so clean!  Love being able to have Dreaming in my pocket
